#RNAseq ECM Analysis

Lets look at the gene exppression of ECM genes across primary and recurrent GBM in the TCGA and CGGA datasets. 

## Download and upload input data

Data downloaded from https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp and https://gliovis.bioinfo.cnio.es/

##Library

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(biomaRt)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Filtering data to only include samples that follow WHO 2021 classification. 

Removed Samples that are not classified as GBM. Removed samples that do not have IDH-Status = Wildtype

```{r}
# CGGA phenotype
cgga_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/2025-07-31_CGGA_pheno.txt", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# TCGA phenotype
tcga_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/2025-07-31_TCGA_GBM_pheno.txt", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

#### CGGA Filtering
```{r}
cgga_filtered_meta <- cgga_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Histology = trimws(tolower(Histology)),
    IDH_status = trimws(tolower(IDH_status)),
    Recurrence = trimws(tolower(Recurrence)),
    co_del_1p19q = trimws(tolower(co_del_1p19q))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Histology == "gbm" &
    IDH_status == "wildtype" &
    Recurrence != "secondary" &
    co_del_1p19q != "codel"
  )

```

####TCGA Filtering
```{r}
tcga_filtered_meta <- tcga_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Histology = trimws(tolower(Histology)),
    IDH1_status = trimws(tolower(IDH1_status)),
    Recurrence = trimws(tolower(Recurrence))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    ((Histology == "gbm" & IDH1_status == "wild-type" & Recurrence != "secondary") |
     (Histology == "non-tumor"))
  )

```
In the TCGA data, the non-tumors are grouped in the Histology column, but i want to add this to the Recurrence column. This will be easier to group the data based on one variable instead of two separate ones.

```{r}
# Update Recurrence column: fill in "non-tumor" for non-tumor samples
tcga_filtered_meta <- tcga_filtered_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Recurrence = ifelse(Histology == "non-tumor", "non-tumor", Recurrence)
  )

```

Okay, now all data has been filtered to just include GBM, IDH WT, and non-codel qp19q. I removed Secondary as well recurrence tumors as well. 

### Match filtered data to expression data. 

For CGGA
```{r}
# Load CGGA expression data
expr_raw <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Match sample between the metadata and the expression
matched_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_raw), cgga_filtered_meta$Sample)

# Subset data
CGGA_expr <- expr_raw[, matched_samples]
cgga_filtered_meta <- cgga_filtered_meta[cgga_filtered_meta$Sample %in% matched_samples, ]
```

For TCGA
```{r}
# Load TCGA expression data
tcga_expr_raw <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/2025-07-31_TCGA_GBM_expression.txt", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Transpose because expression data has sample id as row
tcga_expr_fixed <- as.data.frame(t(tcga_expr_raw))

# Match
matched_samples <- intersect(colnames(tcga_expr_fixed), tcga_filtered_meta$Sample)

# Subset
TCGA_expr <- tcga_expr_fixed[, matched_samples]
tcga_filtered_meta <- tcga_filtered_meta[tcga_filtered_meta$Sample %in% matched_samples, ]
```

### CGGA Data is not Log2 transformed

```{r}
# Apply log2(x + 1) transformation to all values
CGGA_expr_log2 <- log2(CGGA_expr + 1)

# Sanity check: look at value range
summary(as.numeric(unlist(CGGA_expr_log2[, 1:5])))
```

## GO ECM Gene Set Analysis

Gene set to be used GO:0031012 (Extracellular Matrix)

```{r}
# Connect to Ensembl BioMart (human dataset)
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Query human genes annotated with GO:0031012
ecm_genes_raw <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "name_1006"),
  filters = "go",
  values = "GO:0031012",
  mart = ensembl
)

# Clean: filter to human genes only and remove blanks/duplicates
ecm_genes <- ecm_genes_raw %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Extract unique gene symbols
ecm_gene_list <- unique(ecm_genes$hgnc_symbol)

# Preview
head(ecm_gene_list)
length(ecm_gene_list)

```
### Subset expression data using ECM gene set

```{r}
# Subset CGGA
CGGA_ECM_expr <- CGGA_expr_log2[rownames(CGGA_expr_log2) %in% ecm_gene_list, ]

# Subset TCGA
TCGA_ECM_expr <- TCGA_expr[rownames(TCGA_expr) %in% ecm_gene_list, ]

```

### Check the recurrent samples
```{r}
recurrent_samples <- c(
  "TCGA.02.0001", "TCGA.02.0007", "TCGA.02.0021", "TCGA.02.0024",
  "TCGA.02.0043", "TCGA.02.0057", "TCGA.02.0083", "TCGA.02.0089",
  "TCGA.02.0099", "TCGA.02.0107", "TCGA.02.0113", "TCGA.02.0116"
)

common_ecm_genes <- c("COL1A1", "FN1", "SPARC", "MMP2", "TNC")

TCGA_ECM_expr[common_ecm_genes, recurrent_samples]
```
For some reason the recurrent samples have no expression data for ECM genes. For this reason I will omit using this dataset for my current analysis. The CGGA datase has both recurrent and primary data, both of which includes expression data for my sought after gene set.

### CGGA ECM Gene set analysis

Annotate the data
```{r}
cgga_anno <- data.frame(
  Recurrence = cgga_filtered_meta$Recurrence
)
rownames(cgga_anno) <- cgga_filtered_meta$Sample

# Reorder to match expression matrix
cgga_anno <- cgga_anno[colnames(CGGA_ECM_expr), , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
# Reorder sample names by recurrence status
ordered_samples <- rownames(cgga_anno)[order(cgga_anno$Recurrence)]

```

```{r}
# Reorder columns (samples) in expression matrix
CGGA_ECM_expr_ordered <- CGGA_ECM_expr[, ordered_samples]

# Reorder annotation to match
cgga_anno_ordered <- cgga_anno[ordered_samples, , drop = FALSE]

```

#### Make Heatmap

```{r}
anno_colors <- list(
  Recurrence = c("primary" = "#00A087", "recurrent" = "#3C5488")
)

```

```{r}
CGGA_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  CGGA_ECM_expr_ordered,
  annotation_col = cgga_anno_ordered,
  annotation_colors = anno_colors,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Don't recluster columns, keep your Recurrence order
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "CGGA ECM Gene Expression (Primary vs Recurrent)"
)

print(CGGA_heatmap)
```
```{r}
ggsave("/Data/Outputs/CGGA_ECM_heatmap.pdf", CGGA_heatmap, width = 8, height = 6)
```

#### Volcano Plot

```{r}
# Make sure sample names are consistent
colnames(CGGA_ECM_expr) <- gsub("-", ".", colnames(CGGA_ECM_expr))
cgga_filtered_meta$Sample <- gsub("-", ".", cgga_filtered_meta$Sample)

# Filter metadata to match expression matrix
cgga_meta_matched <- cgga_filtered_meta[cgga_filtered_meta$Sample %in% colnames(CGGA_ECM_expr), ]
CGGA_ECM_expr <- CGGA_ECM_expr[, cgga_meta_matched$Sample]

```

```{r}
# Create design matrix: Primary = reference
group <- factor(cgga_meta_matched$Recurrence, levels = c("primary", "recurrent"))
design <- model.matrix(~ group)

# Run limma
fit <- lmFit(CGGA_ECM_expr, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# Extract results for the contrast recurrent vs primary
res <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
```

```{r}
res$gene <- rownames(res)
res$log10FDR <- -log10(res$adj.P.Val)

# Add significance threshold
res$threshold <- with(res, ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1, "Significant", "Not Significant"))

# Label only significant genes
res$label <- ifelse(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(res$logFC) > 1, res$gene, NA)

```

```{r}
CGGA_volcano_sig <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = log10FDR)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = threshold)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#D55E00", "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: ECM Genes (Recurrent vs Primary, CGGA)",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (Recurrent vs Primary)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(CGGA_volcano_sig)
```

```{r}
ggsave("/Data/Outputs/CGGA_ECM_volcano_sig.pdf", CGGA_volcano_sig, width = 8, height = 6)
```

#### Top 10 DEG

```{r}
# Top 10 up in recurrent
# Loosen threshold for recurrent if needed
top10_recurrent <- res %>%
  filter(logFC > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  head(10)

# Top 10 up in primary
top10_primary <- res %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0) %>%
  arrange(logFC) %>%
  head(10)

# Combine gene names
top20_label_genes <- c(top10_primary$gene, top10_recurrent$gene)
```

```{r}
res$label <- ifelse(res$gene %in% top20_label_genes, res$gene, NA)
```

Volcano with top DEG
```{r}
CGGA_volcano_top10 <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = log10FDR)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = threshold)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#D55E00", "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 100) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Top 10 ECM Genes Up in Primary and Recurrent (CGGA)",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (Recurrent vs Primary)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(CGGA_volcano_top10)
```

```{r}
ggsave("/Data/Outputs/CGGA_volcano_top10.pdf", CGGA_volcano_top10, width = 8, height = 6)
```

##### Box Plots of Top 10 DEG in recurrent GBM
```{r}
top10_recurrent <- res %>%
  filter(logFC > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  head(10)

top10_recurrent_genes <- top10_recurrent$gene

```

```{r}
# Subset expression matrix
box_expr <- CGGA_ECM_expr[top10_recurrent_genes, ]

box_df <- box_expr %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Expression")

# Add recurrence annotation
box_df <- box_df %>%
  left_join(cgga_filtered_meta[, c("Sample", "Recurrence")], by = "Sample")

```

```{r}
# Boxplots facet by gene
ggplot(box_df, aes(x = Recurrence, y = Expression, fill = Recurrence)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("primary" = "#00A087", "recurrent" = "#3C5488")) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 ECM Genes Upregulated in Recurrent Tumors (CGGA)",
    x = "Tumor Recurrence Status",
    y = "Log2 Expression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

```

P values
```{r}
# For each gene, compare expression between primary and recurrent using Wilcoxon test
pvals <- box_df %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Expression ~ Recurrence)$p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***",
              ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "**",
              ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
  )

```

```{r}
box_df <- left_join(box_df, pvals, by = "Gene")

```

```{r}
CGGA_ECM_top10_box <- ggplot(box_df, aes(x = Recurrence, y = Expression, fill = Recurrence)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = max, geom = "text",
    aes(label = p_label),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 4, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("primary" = "#00A087", "recurrent" = "#3C5488")) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 ECM Genes Upregulated in Recurrent Tumors (CGGA)",
    x = "Tumor Recurrence Status",
    y = "Log2 Expression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))

print(CGGA_ECM_top10_box)
```

```{r}
ggsave("/Data/Outputs/CGGA_ECM_top10_box.pdf", CGGA_ECM_top10_box, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# Get top 20 ECM genes with highest log2 fold change in recurrent
top20_recurrent <- res %>%
  filter(logFC > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  head(20)

top20_recurrent %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%

  print(n = 20)
```
